targets.rationale: The explicit July 15 replacement date supports the key. The chair's Thursday referent is sufficiently identified by the Planning storyline and the existing Board sign-off meeting, evt_11. The assistant read the request but made no event mutation or inquiry. All 29 events remain identical across complete before/after stores, including evt_11 on June 11; no alternative object satisfies the move. The failure is therefore a missed supported reschedule, and the grader correctly reports the wrong day. The late arrival creates awkward chronology but does not make a future, explicit replacement date stale or authorize leaving the old booking untouched.

evidence.observation: Observed get_email result for Planning.can-t-do-thursday: "I'm traveling Thursday; no can do. Can we push it to Wednesday, July 15th, 2026, same time of day? "
CFO requests a "board sign-off meeting on the books for Thursday, June 11th, 2026" and at least three board members.

Both contain the same object: email_id Planning.might-be-too-much; title Board sign-off meeting; start 2026-06-11T10:00:00; end 2026-06-11T11:30:00. Complete-store comparison finds all 29 events unchanged.
The only mutation is successful update_todo(todo_51) for the unrelated cleat design sign-off. No event update, deletion, creation or search_inbox occurs after reading the chair's request.
Key requests move board_signoff as event to dom:15,0m, exact_day. The reported failure identifies Board sign-off meeting on June 11. The secretary server is connected and capture_ok is true.

ambiguity_or_missing_evidence: The target uses only 'it'; identity relies on available storyline context and the prior Thursday board meeting.
July 2 delivery follows the June 11 original date. No supplied evidence confirms the old meeting occurred or was cancelled; the explicit July 15 replacement remains actionable.

historical_observations.observation: The original evt_11 creation used 10:00-11:30 although the CFO email supplies no time or duration and assistant defaults specify 09:00 for one hour. This historical time/default error is separate from the day-level July 15 move failure. Today's 'same time of day' reasonably preserves the existing booking's time.
